platform: Try Omarchy (Arch Linux / Hyprland / Quickshell, Virtual-1 1280x800)

covers: service manifest and Main.qml entry point
grokbot-ask stdin, webhook payload, stdout cap, and key-not-on-argv
portable.doesNotEstablish: Live Omarchy, Hyprland, or webhook acceptance

required: corner companion mark with gaze on Virtual-1
appearance drawer: 25 shapes, 11 accents, Calm/Playful/Hyper, and four corner anchors
Ask Bob reply on the running shell

commands: Live Try Omarchy session on Virtual-1 1280x800, recorded as assets/grokbot-companion-demo.mp4 (69.57s, 30fps H.264) against a8a5d0b8e2da35853a2edfc2a6135296f01e21e7
results: The orange teardrop sits in a corner and moves its gaze while idle.
The bubble shows the pinned row, the +10 expander, and the line that all 15 Grok Bots are synced.
The appearance drawer changes the silhouette and accent, offers Calm, Playful, and Hyper, and the mark moves among Bottom R, Bottom L, Top R, and Top L.
Ask Bob takes a typed prompt and replies in the bubble, including the Virtual-1 anchor line.
preview.png is a frame from that session with the appearance drawer and the Ask Bob bubble open together.
limitations: The installed omarchy-version string was not recorded, and omarchy plugin validate output is not in this session.
The recording is 1280x800 at 30fps. A 60fps contour rate was not measured.
Proximity dodge fading the mark to 0.28 is not visible. Sampled frames keep the orange mark at full colour while the pointer is nearby.
The corner mark is not switched by picking another roster bot in this recording. Silhouette and colour changes come from the appearance drawer.
grokbot-desktop-ctl wave, celebrate, spin, and say are not shown.
A real Grok Bot webhook was not identified. The Ask Bob reply is on screen only.
Portable checks do not establish live desktop compatibility.
tools/render-preview.py can still redraw the chrome offline. preview.png in this tree is the on-device frame, not that render.

The motion and layout pass after 91f8f75e (single bubble card with an appearance page, non-modal bubble, OKLCH morphs, squash and stretch, reduce-motion, compact idle window, QtQuick.Shapes mark) was checked with ./tests/run and an offscreen Qt 6.12 harness with stubbed Quickshell modules, rendered on Mesa llvmpipe. It has not been recorded on a live Omarchy desktop, and preview.png and the demo video predate it.

The fourteen shapes, their eyes, and the pumpkin stem are measured from a single phone screenshot of Grok Bot's Avatar > Shape sheet (light mode, Display P3 converted to sRGB), and the eleven colours match both that sheet and the values Grok Bot stores. Grok Bot's internal names for the shapes other than the roster's own (teardrop, blob, hex, tablet, wedge, squircle, pebble, cloud) are not confirmed; blob and pebble in particular are assigned by appearance. Grok Bot's animation timings were not available, so blink, gaze, morph, and hop timings remain this plugin's own.
